answer: Unrepeatable Challenge-Digest Registry. Each identity must submit a distinct response whose hash includes the current round’s digest plus a per-agent pearl token it alone possesses; duplicates are rejected instantly. A validator signs each accepted response, and only signed entries earn copper credits usable for transactions. Issuing a fresh token costs the attacker one hardware-attested slot and a fee exceeding expected reward, while replaying an old sonnet hash fails digest matching.
